thread:
rachel: Quick sync — we launch next Wed. Need coordinated launch posts, a short benchmark narrative, webinar copy, and the inbound routing for the seed-credit cohort. Who can own what?
jamal: I can take webinar copy + slides. timeline?
sophia: I’ll own inbound routing + tags for Intercom/Segment. want the routing to fire on first 3 product events + utm_source.
alex: I’ll own the activation nudges (email + in‑app + small RTM). can we keep the nudge flow to 3 touches over 10 days?
rachel: yes. deadline for copy drafts EOD Tue so we can print slides Wed morning. jamal please add 1 slide for the benchmark callout.
jamal: putting a short bench paragraph — focus on "time to 1st useful reply" and cost per meaningful prompt. will sketch: 
```
Median time-to-first-useful-response: ~1.8s (hosted)
Starter tokens uplift: +32% DAU engagement in week 1
```
use language that non-ML PMs can read.
sophia: routing plan: three buckets
- webinar RSVP -> marketing/welcome drip
- seed-credit signup -> product activation journey + immediate nudge
- demo request -> sales queue (tag: high-intent)
I’ll map the Segment traits: `seed_cohort=true`, `first5_calls_lt=24h`
alex: microcopy for activation nudges (first draft):
```
Email subject A: Welcome — here are your starter tokens
Email subject B: You’ve got free tokens — try these prompt templates
In-app: Try the Starter Prompt Pack -> 3 curated prompts to get value fast
SMS (opt-in): Need help getting started? Reply and we’ll schedule a 15m walkthrough.
```
rachel: nice. can we A/B the two subject lines and measure open -> first prompt executed? set metric as FPR (first prompt rate) within 48h.
jamal: putting that metric on the slide. also adding a micro-benchmark table comparing prompt-pack vs open-ended onboarding.
sophia: FYI: I’ll need the CSV of webinar RSVPs + the utm mappings by EOD Tue to wire Segment -> Intercom. whoever owns the landing page please add `utm_campaign=seed-launch` and a hidden field `cohort=starter`.
alex: I’ll wire the experiment in Amplitude and add cohort flags. will also push the email variants into Braze.
marketing-bot: reminder: Webinar scheduled 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC — auto-post to #events in 48h.
rachel: owners recap: Jamal = webinar + benchmark slides; Sophia = inbound routing + segment wiring; Alex = activation nudges + experiments. Action: drop final copy in this thread by Tue EOD. quick standup tomorrow 10:00. :thumbsup:
jamal: ack. will drop copy by EOD Tue.
sophia: ack, will share Segment mapping + tag list.
alex: ack — experiment plan posted once copy is in.
rachel: thanks all — small final note: keep copy tight, 2–3 lines max on launch posts, link to the prompt pack and the webinar. try 1 actionable CTA per channel.
